lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Wednesday's HARC hearing on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — multiple large-scale public hearings covering eight new buildings in Backman Village, the kind of project that reshapes a neighborhood. Tuesday's BOCC meeting is also worth your attention, with two Land Use Code amendments up for action covering natural medicine businesses and nonconforming lots. San Miguel County also holds its sixth housing code working session Wednesday, pushing toward final recommendations on zoning, density, and workforce housing incentives.
